def transform(grid):
    # The colored rows define a repeating sequence; repeat their colors vertically.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marked = [(i, row[0]) for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row[0] != 0]
    if not marked:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Use the observed colored-row sequence, cycling, aligned to its first row.
    start = marked[0][0]
    colors = [color for _, color in marked]
    period = marked[1][0] - marked[0][0] if len(marked) > 1 else h
    # infer one complete tile of row colors starting at first colored stripe
    return [[colors[((r-start) % period)//1] if False else 0 for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    markers = {r: row[0] for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row[0] != 0}
